dedupe_keys.name: atstep gaussian puff atmospheric dispersion model of the rodos nuclear emergency decision support system kit

description: ATSTEP is a Gaussian puff model for the diagnosis and prognosis of atmospheric dispersion, deposition, gamma radiation and doses of released radioactivity after accidents at nuclear power plants, during the transport of nuclear material, or from dirty bombs. It was developed by Forschungszentrum Karlsruhe, now the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, and is designed to run inside RODOS, the Real-time On-line DecisiOn Support system for nuclear emergency management. The Wikipedia article says RODOS is operational at the German Federal Office for Radiation Protection and in test operation in many other European countries. Coverage is any release location handled by RODOS, mainly European. Access: the page does not offer the model for download and no software licence is stated, so use is through RODOS; how the model is obtained is not stated. Caveats: the article is a short encyclopedic entry and does not give inputs, equations or validation, so the fields for inputs and outputs are limited to what the page says. It suits emergency response and exposure studies for nuclear accidents, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
